topic: Silvertown explosion (1917): a fire at a TNT works beside crowded terraces set off about 50 tons of explosive at 6.52 pm
research_cautions: Quantity is given as 50 tonnes (London Museum) or 53 tons (Historic England); say 'about 50 tons'.
The inquiry did not rule out sabotage but found a spark-started fire likely; the report stayed secret until the 1950s.
